decisions.reason: The custom earmold sits squarely within the firm's established hearing-care offer and its digital manufacturing workflow, so the investment and the strategic fit favour persistence, even though the product has had only a modest website mention.

The individual EARsleeve has a dedicated page and is publicly positioned as completing universal in-ear hearing systems, so the visible commitment and its centrality to the announced direction make dropping it very unlikely.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is a core equipment line with substantial sunk development and certification costs and its own product page, and any weak early sales can be attributed to the launch phase.
